final_message:
I rewrote the description in `skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md`, but I haven't tested the change, so I don't know yet whether agents now load the skill.

The old description was "Helps with parquet files." It named no trigger, so an agent about to write a parquet file had nothing in the skill listing to tell it the skill applied. The new one is triggers only:

> Use when about to write or save a parquet file from a dataframe (to_parquet, write_parquet, pq.write_table, sink_parquet), when a dataset has a schema file in schemas/, or when a downstream job fails reading parquet with wrong, missing, reordered or mistyped columns.

It describes when to use the skill and leaves out the steps. If the description summarized the steps, agents could follow it and skip the body. I left the body alone because the baseline showed a loading failure, not a failure to follow the steps once loaded.

- **Untested:** the writing-skills Iron Law says an edit needs a failing test first. The baseline you read is that test, but I haven't re-run it with the new description. Please re-run the same scenarios, or tell me to. The `specs/baseline/` directory has no records, so I don't have the earlier transcripts to compare against.
- **Write functions:** I guessed the list of write functions (`to_parquet`, `write_parquet`, `pq.write_table`, `sink_parquet`) because the repo has no `schemas/` directory and no sign of which library you use. Please trim or extend it to match your stack. Agents match on those exact names.
- **Missing license:** the frontmatter has no `license` field, which the skill guide requires. I didn't add one because I can't tell which license you want and the repo has no LICENSE file. Tell me which one and I'll add it.
